newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says 9-mth rice output to rise by 1.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila says 9-mth rice output to rise by 1.05 pct.

text.p: The harvest of unmilled rice in the Philippines is forecast to increase by 1.05 percent in the first nine months of the year to 7.14 million tonnes, Agriculture Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban said on Tuesday.
No comparative figures were given for the same period last year but in the whole of 1996, unmilled rice production rose seven percent to 11.28 million tonnes.
Panganiban, in a report released by the University of Asia and the Pacific, said growth was slowing for several reasons including a shift to other crops, pest infestation and land-use conversion.
Panganiban also said corn output is likely to increase by 5.48 percent this year due to the favourable corn prices and better corn seed.

"More plantings are expected in July-September 1997 as corn production may increase by 9.93 percent over last year as shifting from other crops to corn occur and due to re-planting in some areas in Moslem donimated Mindanao lands," he said in his report.
